text:
I put the disc back in the PlayStation. I had to know where the little boat was.

The game loaded straight into the lamp room. No title screen. The clockwork was already wound. I walked to the glass and waited for the beam to come around.

Eight boats, right where they always were.

And at the bottom of the pier, tied to the last post with a short rope, the rowing boat. Empty. The lamp on its hook still burning.

The counter in the corner of the screen said zero.

Then, from the bottom of the staircase, I heard the door open.
